### Songs from God - Truth For Life - October 19
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-19-2020.html
Passage: Job 35:10
Points:
- Anyone can readily praise God during times of prosperity, health, and daylight.
- Singing genuine praise while experiencing darkness, desert seasons, or severe suffering requires divine enablement.
- Even when every earthly resource fails, God's people can rejoice in the Lord as Habakkuk did.
- Affliction should not silence believers, who can look to their Maker to grant melodies of thanksgiving.
